title: Why Do Humans Tell Stories?
paragraphs: People love stories. Parents tell stories to children. Friends tell stories at dinner. We watch stories in films.
People told stories a very long time ago. They told them around a fire. They did not write them. They remembered them.
Stories help us remember things. A story is easier to remember than a list of facts.
Stories also help us understand other people. We feel happy or sad with the people in the story.
